note: Exceptions for tooling/check-public-api.mjs. `companionExports`: non-component symbols the `./components` entry deliberately carries alongside the component they belong to. `pendingMerge`: Vue component exports that are public today but not catalog symbols, each tracked by a duplication id and the step that must clear it; the gate fails in --strict mode while this list is non-empty. `nativeCompanions`: public native symbols that are not catalog components but are deliberate host-facing API next to one (sliver forms, providers); tooling/check-dead-components.mjs treats them as live.

companionExports.flareIcons: Semantic icon-name → glyph table of FlareIcon (the same names natives resolve to SF Symbols / Material Icons).
companionExports.flareIconNames: The ordered icon-name list of FlareIcon, for pickers and docs.
companionExports.FlareIconName: Type of the icon names above.

flutter.FlareConversationSliverList: Sliver form of ConversationList for CustomScrollView hosts (flare-core-flutter-app conversation_list_screen.dart).
flutter.FlareMessageSliverList: Sliver form of MessageList for CustomScrollView hosts (flare-core-flutter-app chat_screen.dart).
flutter.FlareDialog: Base dialog primitive DangerConfirm and hosts build on (flare-core-flutter-app, flare-social-flutter-app).
flutter.ComposerInlineTextField: Composer text-field part hosts embed in their own bars (flare-core-flutter-app message_composer.dart / composer_sheets.dart); the Vue counterpart is the composer's internal input row.

compose.FlarePlatformProvider: Layer 5 platform provider (spec/platform-contract.json); hosts install their adapter through it.
